query: Where are Teide National Park and Garajonay National Park located?

pipeline_result.response: Teide National Park is located in the center and north of La Gomera, one of the Canary Islands (Spain).
retrieved_context: Teide National Park: Teide National Park (Spanish: "Parque nacional del Teide" , ] ) is a national park located in Tenerife (Canary Islands, Spain).

Tenerife: Tenerife ( ; ] ) is the largest and most populated island of the seven Canary Islands.  It is also the most populated island of Spain, with a land area of 2034.38 km2 and 898,680 inhabitants, 43 percent of the total population of the Canary Islands.  Tenerife is the largest and most populous island of Macaronesia.

Garajonay National Park: Garajonay National Park (Spanish: "Parque nacional de Garajonay" , ] ) is located in the center and north of the island of La Gomera, one of the Canary Islands (Spain).  It was declared a national park in 1981 and a World Heritage Site by UNESCO in 1986.  It occupies 40 km (15 sq mi) and it extends into each of the six municipalities on the island.
